designations.fra: Substitution of standard weights at verification

eng: Substitution of standard weights at verification

terms.designation: Substitution of standard weights at verification

definitions.content:
When testing instruments at the place of use (application), instead of standard weights any other constant load may be used, provided that standard weights of at least 1/2 Max are used.

If the repeatability error is not greater than 0.3 e, the portion of standard weights may be reduced to 1/3 Max.

If the repeatability error is not greater than 0.2 e, this portion may be reduced to 1/5 Max.

The repeatability error has to be determined with a load (weights or any other load) of about the value where the substitution is made, by placing it 3 times on the load receptor.
